item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will linger over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days and will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. With the anticyclone aloft over the western North Pacific extending westwards, showers will lessen over the coast of Guangdong early next week, but the trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China again midweek next week.

Weather: Cloudy to overcast with heavy showers and squally thunderstorms.
Temp range: 25 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
